Paid partnership with ImagineArt #Ad

➜ Agent prompt: 

Create a 15-second hyper-realistic video set in Tokyo at night.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

Aspect ratio: 3:4 vertical
Target dimensions: 552 × 736 pixels
Duration: 15 seconds
Video model: MiniMax H3 Max

Do not increase the resolution beyond 552 × 736 simply to improve quality.

Do not create multiple video variations.

Do not create previews, alternate takes, upscales, or additional assets unless they are absolutely required to complete the requested video.

CHARACTER

The protagonist is Woman 1, a stylish Japanese woman in her mid-to-late 20s with model-like features and a contemporary Tokyo appearance. She has a modern dark layered hairstyle with natural movement and face-framing pieces.

Her clothing has a strong current Y2K streetwear influence, but it must look fashionable and authentic rather than like a Y2K costume. Use fitted layers, subtle metallic details, a compact shoulder bag, and contemporary footwear. She should look like someone you could genuinely encounter in a fashionable Tokyo neighborhood today.

Keep Woman 1's face, body, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories consistent throughout the entire video. Her skin must have realistic natural texture and visible detail. Avoid glossy skin, plastic-looking faces, CGI appearance, or an animated AI-video look.

SCENE 1 — approximately 4 seconds

Woman 1 walks along an active Tokyo street at night and enters a contemporary convenience store. Keep Woman 1 clearly visible while establishing the environment. The street feels active and lived-in, with pedestrians, traffic, storefront illumination, and authentic Japanese signage. Her movement into the store should feel spontaneous and natural rather than staged.

SCENE 2 — approximately 7 seconds

Inside the convenience store, Woman 1 selects a cold drink from a refrigerated case and walks to a modern self-checkout terminal.

The store should look like an ordinary, contemporary Tokyo convenience store, not a futuristic interpretation: bright practical lighting, organized narrow aisles, refrigerated cases, shelves filled with believable Japanese products, and modern checkout technology.

At the self-checkout area, Woman 1 notices an interesting local event flyer posted nearby. She pauses naturally, looks at it with genuine interest, takes out her phone, and photographs it. This is a small incidental discovery, not a dramatic moment.

She then scans her drink and completes the purchase using contactless payment.

SCENE 3 — approximately 4 seconds

Woman 1 puts her phone away, takes her drink, and exits through the automatic doors. She steps back onto the active Tokyo night street and naturally joins the pedestrian flow. End with her continuing through the environment. She should not stop and pose for the camera.

DRINK AND PACKAGING

The drink is a realistic 500 mL PET bottle with an original fictional Japanese beverage brand. Give it professionally designed contemporary Japanese packaging with believable label hierarchy, restrained typography, realistic product information, and proper Japanese writing.

Do not reproduce an existing beverage brand. The product should simply look convincing enough that it could genuinely be sitting in a Tokyo convenience-store refrigerator.

TEXT AND ENVIRONMENTAL AUTHENTICITY

Any visible Japanese signage, product packaging, event-flyer typography, or other readable environmental text must consist of real, correctly written Japanese or contextually appropriate English. Do not generate gibberish, fake Japanese characters, meaningless words, or obviously distorted AI typography.

VISUAL STYLE

Prioritize photorealism above everything else. The video should have believable human movement, realistic physics, natural skin texture, ordinary environmental imperfections, and authentic nighttime lighting.

It should feel like something captured naturally on a high-end smartphone while following Woman 1 through Tokyo, not like a commercial, fashion shoot, CGI render, or highly polished cinematic production.

Maintain the quality and realism of the source imagery throughout the video. Do not introduce an animated or synthetic appearance as the video progresses.

COST CONTROL

This is also a credit-usage test. Use the minimum number of generation operations necessary to produce this one finished 15-second video. Do not automatically add previews, prompt enhancement, additional generations, alternate versions, upscaling, or other credit-consuming operations.

Before generating, tell me whether MiniMax H3 Max can actually produce 3:4 at 552 × 736. If it cannot output those exact dimensions, tell me the closest supported resolution and aspect ratio and wait for my approval before generating anything.

Also tell me the estimated total credit cost, if available, before starting the generation.

Do not generate anything until I explicitly approve the production after you answer those two questions.

so much of our current landscape was shaped by the previous generation of digital tools for intellectual topology, that were in fact quite crude and unknowing

Google figured out the first parts, with backlinks to detect hubs of authority within the nascent Internet 

this was soon gamed, of course, with SEO, and the technologies evolved in a stepwise fashion, slowly slowly, up until AI which was a major step change in actually understanding the relationship between things

so we’ve only very recently begun to emerge from 20 years of associative maps, that only understand affiliation and association, into an age of much richer maps that understand meaning structure and relationships much MUCH better

the old age still overhangs our politics, our socialization, our perspectives and reflexes, and it will take time to adapt this new age, which is actually much more human than the previous age, when so much was mediated by these strange subhuman yet totally ubiquitous proto AI systems—the recommendation engines, the google search results, the social media feeds, all well below the level of good human guidance, but widely deployed into everyone hands, particularly children who turned to the idiot gods of their phones before the more difficult and less pleasing human authorities of their life

so that age is closing now, and none too soon!

Reinforcement Learning: One motivator for simulating such everyday life situations is to train the AI. 

The idea is to create scenario's where the girls can gossip and then score it based on:
Novelty - Refreshing, Surprising, Non-human.
Pleasantness - How much regular dudes like it 🤠👍
Consistency - It should make logical sense, even if its very different from normal human behavior.

The hardest part is making the scoring function. One typical approach from inverse reinforcement learning is to train a classifier based on my own hand labeled responses (at least initially). LLM as a judge is another way but this also needs a lot of human labeled examples for context that helps approximate human preference.

But if I figure all that out and train it for a few thousand epochs, should be interesting personalities. Training specilized personalitiy LLM's will be a new future art form 😘🤖🚀
